verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state individual subscribers can opt out of having their code/prompts used for AI model training at any time, which directly satisfies the story. However, the evidence only covers individual-level opt-out, not an org/enterprise-wide policy control an engineering-lead would need to enforce across a team, and community commentary expresses skepticism about whether enterprises can truly guarantee their code isn't used for training. Missing for 10: enterprise/org-wide opt-out documentation, independent verification of enforcement, and enterprise admin controls for training-data policy.
